items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I know Willie used to tell stories about when he was with Harry James... And so -- other times Harry James would be told he couldn't go on if he let Willie play.

ctx.x: Yeah, but he had a problem down South when he played down South because once a policeman once told him come off that bandstand. He said, you can't be playing with them. You come off that stand. But he had to carry his birth certificate around with him. That's the only way we could -- he could get to play with us.

I know Willie used to tell stories about when he was with Harry James, and how they would -- advance word would get to these other cities that Harry James had a mixed band. There was one Negro in the band. And so, the sheriff would come up and say to Harry James you can't go on with a mixed band. And Harry would say, all right, point out the one that mixes it.
